semantic_scope: All nonempty noncommand nonpadding timeline cells; row zero exec names are used in episode notifications. Provisional name readings are not final-release approved.

rendering_contract.keep_fullwidth_digits_in_csv: Reader strips ASCII at beginning of base/alt fields; normalizer narrows digits after parsing.
rendering_contract.newlines: actual LF inside quoted cells, not literal backslash+n

context_review.scope: 355 cells against complete source timeline and neighboring columns/rows

findings_resolved.change: Keep daughter directly addressing her father in bright informal speech.
Use source-compatible corner quotes at cell start to satisfy conservative parser-leading-character guard; meaning unchanged. This was a static guard, not an observed game failure.

notes: 紅葉 is mother and もみじ is daughter; both モミジ, with relationship added only at r026c04 where both occur.
反魂/反魂樹/禊ぎ/ミッションスクール/公園墓地 terminology follows existing source-backed decisions.
Uncertain name readings are proposals, not final approval.
All source narrative facts including fictional medical claims retained as fiction; no external semantic translation used.
